002-1-lexical-structure-example-001.code:
var x = a
!b            // 两条语句；不是 var x = a!

en.6: // two statements; NOT var x = a!

002-1-lexical-structure-example-002.code:
var ok = check(a)
    && check(b)      // 续行

var total = base +
            extra    // 运算符置于行尾，续行

var quotient = total
    / 2              // 除法只有中缀角色，续行

en.18: // operator parked at end of line; continuation
en.24: // division has only an infix role; continuation

002-1-lexical-structure-example-003.code:
var d = (total
    - used)          // 括号组内行结尾透明

en.8: // line endings are transparent inside a bracket group

002-1-lexical-structure-example-010.code:
r"C:\path\to\file"          // 字面量包含两个反斜杠
r"C:\Users\${USER}"         // 反斜杠不转义，但 ${USER} 仍插值

en.2: // backslash is not escaped, but ${USER} still interpolates

002-1-lexical-structure-example-011.code:
"Hello, ${name}!"
r"C:\\path\\${name}"   // 反斜杠原样，仍插值
b"\\x89PNG"              // escaped [u8; 4]
br"${HOME}\\bin"         // raw bytes；`${HOME}` 不插值
c"puts"                   // [u8; 5]，最后一项是 appended NUL
cr"C:\\assets"           // raw C bytes + appended NUL

en.2: // backslashes are raw; interpolation remains active

002-1-lexical-structure-example-013.code:
const HTML = r"""
${title}
""" const SCRIPT = br"""" echo ${HOME} """ """"

002-1-lexical-structure-example-014.code:

var zh: rune = '中'
var smile: rune = '\u{1F600}'

002-1-lexical-structure-example-015.code:
var letters = re"(?i)[a-z]+"
var decimal = re"\d+\.\d+"
